title: 第3章 陈景言教训吴子毅第4章 傻子大闹吴家
content_zh:
陈景言都无语了，这个混蛋怎么这么不知死活？难道他觉得这个世上就没有他怕的人了吗？
一个纨绔子弟被吴家宠成这样，简直是一种悲哀！
既然他主动送上门来，那就不客气了
想到这儿，陈景言嘴角微扬，眼神骤然冷冽，下一秒骤然出手，一记干脆利落的耳光落在吴子毅脸上。
“啪！”清脆响亮的声音在别墅的客厅里回荡。
吴子毅的身子被扇飞了出去，“吧唧”摔在地板上。
“扑哧！”一口鲜血从吴子毅嘴里喷出，还有两颗牙齿也被打掉了，随着鲜血喷了出来。
鲜血染红了地板，血水里面有两个雪白的牙齿。
全场瞬间死寂，所有人都愣住了，都不敢相信眼前这一幕。
吴子毅趴在地上，半边脸迅速肿起，嘴角淌血，眼中满是惊恐与难以置信。
陈景言也震惊到了，他只是轻描淡写地出了不到两成力，竟造成如此效果，看来这具身体的潜能远超预期。
因为他已经感觉到了，吴子毅是修炼之人，修为应该达到玄级。
而陈景言轻轻一巴掌，竟将玄级修为的吴子毅打得如此惨烈，足见其肉身强度已突破常理。
不过他还得继续装傻，才能更好地隐藏实力。
“嘿嘿嘿......我说过，傻子会打人，让你别招惹傻子，你就是不信，嘿嘿嘿......”
陈景言的父母和姐姐终于反应过来了，他们从沙发上跃起来，忙不迭跑过去，把吴子毅从地上搀扶起来。
陈景言的大姐吴秀芸过来指着陈景言就破口大骂：“傻子，你一回来就打人，你想死吗？”
陈景言的母亲李丽雨也急忙附和：“你这傻子，怎么一回来就闯祸？真是个灾星。”
其余家庭成员，你一言我一语，对陈景言就是一通臭骂，骂得十分难听。
陈景言站在原地，嘴角依旧挂着那抹痴傻的笑，他指着吴秀芸问道：“你是不是也想挨打？”

吴秀芸被吓得连连后退。
全场再度陷入死寂，无人敢信这个傻子竟敢如此放肆。
吴秀芸脸色惨白，指着他的手颤抖不止，却再也说不出一句完整的话。
看到吴家人惊恐不安的样子，陈景言内心暗自好笑，不过他现在的身份就是一个傻子，所以他只能继续扮演傻子的角色。
“嘿嘿嘿......傻子，你们都是傻子。”
吴家人这才放下心来，陈景言再强，他始终是个傻子，没什么可怕的。
这时，一直沉默的吴家老爷子吴天雄终于开口。
他拄着拐杖，重重地在地板上敲了一下，发出沉闷的响声，浑浊却锐利的目光扫过陈景言，带着一丝审视和不易察觉的复杂情绪：“够了！成何体统！景言刚回来，你们就这样吵吵闹闹，像什么样子！”
content_en:
Chen Jingyan was speechless. How could this bastard be so reckless? Does he feel that there is no one in this world that he is afraid of?
It is simply sad that a playboy is pampered like this by the Wu family!
Since he took the initiative to deliver it to your door, you're welcome
Thinking of this, Chen Jingyan's lips slightly raised, his eyes suddenly turned cold, and the next second he suddenly took action, landing a sharp slap on Wu Ziyi's face.
"Bang!" A clear and loud voice echoed in the living room of the villa.
Wu Ziyi's body was kicked out and fell to the floor.
"Plop!" A mouthful of blood spurted out from Wu Ziyi's mouth, and two teeth were also knocked out, spurting out with the blood.
Blood stained the floor red, and there were two white teeth in the blood.
The whole place fell silent for a moment, and everyone was stunned, unable to believe the scene in front of them.
Wu Ziyi lay on the ground, half of his face swollen rapidly, blood dripped from the corner of his mouth, and his eyes were full of horror and disbelief.
Chen Jingyan was also shocked. He only exerted less than 20% of his strength lightly, but it actually had such an effect. It seemed that the potential of this body far exceeded expectations.
Because he has already felt that Wu Ziyi is a cultivator, and his cultivation level should reach Xuan level.
And Chen Jingyan's gentle slap hit Wu Ziyi, who was a Xuan-level cultivator, so violently, which shows that his physical strength has exceeded normal standards.
However, he has to continue to act stupid in order to better hide his strength.
"Hehehehe...I said that fools will beat people up, so I told you not to provoke fools, but you just don't believe it, hehehehe..."
Chen Jingyan's parents and sister finally reacted. They jumped up from the sofa and hurriedly ran over to help Wu Ziyi up from the ground.
Chen Jingyan's eldest sister Wu Xiuyun came over and pointed at Chen Jingyan and yelled: "Idiot, you beat people as soon as you come back. Do you want to die?"
Chen Jingyan's mother Li Liyu also hurriedly echoed: "You idiot, why do you get into trouble as soon as you come back? What a disaster star."
The rest of the family members scolded Chen Jingyan in a very unpleasant way.
Chen Jingyan stood there with that silly smile still hanging on his lips. He pointed at Wu Xiuyun and asked, "Do you also want to be beaten?"
Wu Xiuyun was so frightened that she backed away repeatedly.
The whole place fell into dead silence again, no one dared to believe that this fool dared to be so presumptuous.
Wu Xiuyun's face was pale, her hand pointing at him was shaking, but she could no longer say a complete sentence.
Seeing the Wu family's frightened look, Chen Jingyan was secretly amused, but his current identity was that of a fool, so he could only continue to play the role of a fool.
"Hey hey hey...fool, you are all fools."
The Wu family was relieved. No matter how strong Chen Jingyan was, he was still a fool and there was nothing to fear.
At this time, Wu Tianxiong, the old man of the Wu family who had been silent, finally spoke.
He leaned on his crutch and knocked on the floor hard, making a dull sound. His muddy but sharp eyes swept over Chen Jingyan, with a trace of scrutiny and unnoticeable complex emotions: "Enough! How unbecoming! Jing Yan just came back, and you are making such a noise, what does it look like!"
